title: MT-Adapted Datasheets for Datasets: Template and Repository
reasoning: The paper's primary contribution is the adaptation of a datasheet template, with a central motivation being to enhance transparency and ethical evaluation of datasets in Machine Translation. It introduces new, explicit questions designed to make users 'study the ethics of it,' such as whether a dataset's use could 'interfere with human will or communicate a false reality' and if there is bias related to 'gender, ethics'. This focus on creating a tool for ethical scrutiny is a core component of the work, not a peripheral section.
